cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Will you help me set up Denise's surprise leaving party at seven?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I spent the last one washing glasses.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. I'll wash up. Could you get Denise out of the office while I decorate?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She won't leave before I finish her spreadsheet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Send it over. I'll finish her spreadsheet; could you take her for coffee and complain about how little I do?

mechanism: A claims mere calendar assistance while reallocating meeting and work time so B can join a covert leaving-party setup.
confusable: Not only volunteering to help: A decides the timetable and absorbs the obstacle while B performs the secret diversion.
comparison: Mum pastry distraction versus colleague coffee cover.
